subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this umbrella stay open until both the configurable cron cadence guardrail and the guarded cron base-session retention semantics are accepted or rejected?
rationale: The source-backed gaps are real, but the remaining fixes add compatibility-sensitive core config and cleanup semantics that require maintainer product intent rather than a safe automatic close or duplicate repair.

options.title: Keep Open For Linked Guardrail And Retention Slices
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90194, then split only any leftover warning or cleanup work.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Now
options.body: Make narrower canonical issues for cadence limits, retention cleanup, context warnings, and sessions cleanup, then close this umbrella only after those refs are linked.

options.title: Reject Core Guardrails
options.body: Close or narrow the cadence guardrail direction if maintainers decide cron frequency policy should remain documentation-only or external to core.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Linked Guardrail And Retention Slices
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90194, then split only any leftover warning or cleanup work.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight owns the active configurable cadence guardrail PR and already made the maintainer-facing call that the warning-only path is superseded by that direction.
